characters.continuity: Mad Max film series (2015 film Mad Max: Fury Road)
characters.summary: Immortan Joe is a ruthless wasteland warlord who maintains control over water resources and commands a fanatic army of War Boys using heavily modified vehicles and fear.
weaknesses: Dependent on a life-support breathing apparatus
limitations: Frail physical body relying on breathing support and specialized armor

sources.supports: Immortan Joe's role as the warlord of the Citadel controlling water and warriors.

feats.claim: Maintained autocratic rule over a massive post-apocalyptic settlement by rationing water

notableResults.note: Killed by Furiosa during pursuit on the Fury Road.

unknowns: Pre-collapse military rank and exact medical history.

characters.continuity: Mad Max film series (2015 film Mad Max: Fury Road)
characters.summary: Imperator Furiosa is a hardened wasteland warrior and master driver of the massive War Rig who uses combat skills, firearms, and mechanical aptitude to lead a daring rescue.

techniques: Hand-to-hand combat with a prosthetic arm

mechanisms: Prosthetic arm used in blocking melee attacks

weaknesses: Missing left arm, relying on a mechanical prosthetic
limitations: Vulnerable to fuel depletion, ammunition limits, and mechanical failure of her vehicle

sources.supports: Furiosa's role as War Rig driver and leader of the rescue mission.

feats.claim: Successfully drove the War Rig across treacherous wasteland terrain while evading and fighting Immortan Joe's entire armada

notableResults.note: Killed Immortan Joe by ripping off his breathing mask and jaw during a vehicular battle.

unknowns: Exact years spent in servitude before escaping.
